ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
ourKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
ourKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
ourKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
ourKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
ourKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

ourKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Pick up Boulder Throw, Pounce in to shatter it on landing for an area stun, Rumble to slow, then Behemoth to grow, heal and get an instant Boulder Throw and longer Pounce.
enemyKits.winCondition: Engage with Pounce and Boulder Throw, then out-sustain fights in Behemoth, especially near several enemies.
enemyKits.passive: King of the Jungle: bonus health regeneration, doubled in the jungle, and tenacity plus a heal when he is immobilized.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that punishes the targets he stuns and knocks back.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge the thrown boulder and watch for him carrying one before a Pounce. Anti-heal cuts his regeneration and Behemoth healing, and kiting him out of Behemoth's duration wastes it.

enemyKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
enemyKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
enemyKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Hydroclasm bubble to slow, Narcosis to suspend a hero, pop the amplified bubble with Brine for extra damage and penetration, then Genesis knockup.
enemyKits.winCondition: Poke with bubbles popped by Fathom and Brine, then catch a hero with Narcosis and burst them.
enemyKits.passive: Herald changes his kit based on the chosen Eternal category, from damage and cooldowns to healing or anti-heal.
enemyKits.playWith: Teammates with follow-up damage or CC that can hit a hero he suspends.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Narcosis stops on the first hero it hits, so a tanky teammate can block it for a carry. Leave a bubble's radius before it amplifies, and fight after Narcosis is down; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
enemyKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
enemyKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

Toughness: +450 health; took 29,931 damage, mitigated 22,221, died 4 times.

bullets: Behemoth heals a share of maximum health per second, more per nearby enemy hero, so Krix's bonus health and Forticus's gain in hero fights made each tick bigger.
Krix grew maximum health with each level, Cannibalism added permanent maximum health on every takedown, and Regenerative Tissue regenerated health after a stretch without taking hero damage.
Each basic attack set off Overlord's splash and Rapture's on-hit damage near enemies, while enemies basic attacking Rampage took Tainted Guard's bleed and a healing cut.
Ability hits set off Megacosm's damage over time and Combustion's area burst on a cooldown, Caustica added damage to heroes above 50% health with bonus magical armor.
Vesh added damage over time after each ability hit on heroes, Mind Rot added bonus damage from the target's current health, and Lich gave Ikra magical lifesteal.
Tainted Scepter cut enemy healing on magical damage and built Malice stacks once per second; takedowns filled all 15 at once for heavier ability hits.
